title: I Would Like: szeretnék vs. szeretne

sections.content: The conditional of szeret gives 'would like'. szeretnék is first-person singular ('I would like'); szeretne is third-person singular, and also doubles as the polite form used when addressing someone as Ön.

rows: he/she would like / you (polite) would like

sections.content: szeretnék and szeretne differ by only one letter but mean different people -- double-check which one you're using, since mixing them up swaps 'I' for 'he/she/you (polite)'.
